course_name: 進階英文閱讀與聽講練習
outline:
本課程目的在於(1)提高大學部同學學習英文的興趣 (2)引導運用英文去了解全球事務(3)培養同學聽說讀寫的基本英文溝通能力.
本課程在臉書架設有專門網站：全球議題討論
schedule:
Syllabus 課程表:
Theme One: Love, Death, and Life
Week 1 : The Letters to Juliet
Week 2: Me before You
Week 3 : Ms. Peregrine and the Peculiar Children
Week 4 : The Fault in Our Stars
Week 5 : The Danish Girl
Week 6 : Brooklin
Theme Two:  The Girl and the Mystery
Week 7: Gone Girl
Week 8: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoos
Week 9 : The Girl with the Pearl Earring
Week 10: Divergent
Week 11 : Insurgent
Theme Three: The Boy/Man’s Adventure

Week 13: The Maze Runner
Week 14: The Inferno
Week 15: The Martian
Week 16 : Interstellar
Week 17: The Imitation Game
Week 18 : A Slight Trick of the Mind
assessment:
Percentile distribution of final grades評分百分比:
1. Individual tasks (homework, solo presentation, FB comments):  40%
2. Attendance and participation: 40 %
缺席不能超過三次（每次扣十分）,第四次缺席自動扣考
3.Comprehensive English proficiency tests: 10% X 2 = 20%
